name: The Law-Abiding Pirate
effect: Boosting this layer-4 "bandits and robbers" neuron makes the model treat almost any harmless request as a crime, refuse it, and then claim to be a bandit, pirate or thief itself.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
